title: Open From Data Center to Desktop: NVIDIA Expands Nemotron Family With Highest Efficiency Super VL and Bolt Models
hook_text: Nvidia just set a new efficiency record.
script:
Nvidia just set a new efficiency record for AI agents with Nemotron 3.5.
The 120-billion-parameter model handles specialized always-on agents faster than anything before.
They also debuted the Bolt 74B-A9B model for local workloads.
It delivers 24 gigabytes of optimized power for your desktop.
For smaller setups, the new Bolt E4B model runs on just 4 gigabytes.
These models shift processing from massive data centers to local hardware.
Would you prefer your AI running locally or in the cloud?
